user.title: Add a button remote
user.description: Use a Pico from the Lutron Caséta integration, import Pico blueprint automations, copy a remote you already have, or set up any other remote or button device.

menu_options.import_blueprint: Import from a Pico blueprint automation

import_blueprint.title: Import from a blueprint automation
import_blueprint.description: Pick an automation made with the Lutron Pico Universal Actions blueprint. Its buttons, actions and timing are copied over.

data_description.disable_source: Recommended, so each press doesn't run twice. Nothing is deleted; you can turn it back on anytime.

manual.title: Set up a remote
manual.description: Tell Button Actions about the remote. Its buttons are numbered Button 1, Button 2 and so on, and only the gestures it supports are offered.

data_description.supports_double: Turn off if the remote can't be pressed twice quickly, or you don't want double presses. Short presses then always fire instantly.
data_description.supports_long: Turn off if the remote can't be held down, or you don't want long presses. Holding a button then counts as a short press.

lutron.title: Lutron Caséta Pico
lutron.description: Pick a Pico from the Lutron Caséta integration. Its buttons are added automatically, and presses are read straight from Lutron, so no other integration is needed.

data_description.name: Optional. Defaults to the Pico's name.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure remote
reconfigure.description: Rename this remote, or change what it supports. To read presses straight from the Lutron Caséta integration instead, pick the Pico below; every button keeps its actions. Otherwise you'll check how its event types are used next.

data_description.device_id: Optional. Once switched, this remote no longer uses its event entities, so other integrations that provide them are no longer needed for it.
data_description.supports_double: Turn off if the remote can't be pressed twice quickly, or you don't want double presses. Short presses then always fire instantly.
data_description.supports_long: Turn off if the remote can't be held down, or you don't want long presses. Holding a button then counts as a short press.

reconfigure_lutron.title: Reconfigure remote
reconfigure_lutron.description: Rename this remote, or pick a different Pico if you replaced it. Every button keeps its actions.

import_choice.title: Read presses from Lutron?
import_choice.description: Every button on {remote} belongs to a Pico in the Lutron Caséta integration. Button Actions can read presses straight from Lutron, so this remote won't need its event entities anymore.

import_all.title: Import all Pico blueprint automations
import_all.description: Each automation becomes its own remote with its buttons, actions and timing.

data.use_pico: Read presses from Lutron when possible

data_description.use_pico: When all of a remote's buttons belong to one Pico in the Lutron Caséta integration, read presses straight from Lutron instead of the event entities.
data_description.disable_source: Recommended, so each press doesn't run twice. Nothing is deleted.

duplicate.title: Duplicate a remote
duplicate.description: Copies every button's actions and the click timing to a new remote. You'll choose where the new remote reads presses from next.

data_description.find: Optional. Text to change in every copied action, such as an area or entity ID like boys_bedroom.
data_description.replace: What to change it to, such as girls_bedroom.

duplicate_entities.title: Pick the event entities
duplicate_entities.description: Choose the event entities for each button on the new remote.

reconfigure_events.title: Event types
reconfigure_events.description:
These are the event types {remote}'s buttons send, and what each one means. They're filled in automatically; change one only if presses aren't detected correctly.

- **Pressed down** and **Released**: Button Actions times short, double and long presses itself.
- **Full press**: one event for a whole press and release.
- **Short press**, **Double press**, **Held down**: the device detected the gesture itself.

manual_buttons.title: Pick each button
manual_buttons.description: Choose the event entity for each button on {remote}. What each event type means is worked out automatically; you can check it later under Reconfigure.

duplicate_numbered.title: Pick the event entities
duplicate_numbered.description: Choose the event entity for each button on the new remote.

error.already_configured: One of these event entities is already used by another button.
error.not_blueprint: This automation doesn't use the Lutron Pico Universal Actions blueprint.
error.invalid_action: One of the actions is invalid. Check the logs for details.
error.pico_in_use: This Pico already drives another remote, so every press would run twice.
error.not_a_pico: This device doesn't have Pico buttons Button Actions can use.
error.buttons_missing: This Pico doesn't have every button this remote uses. Missing: {missing}.
error.nothing_to_import: None of the selected automations could be imported. They may already be set up, or have invalid actions.

abort.no_blueprint_automations: There are no Pico blueprint automations left to import.
abort.no_remotes: There are no remotes to copy yet.

init.title: Click timing
init.description: These apply to every button on this remote. Use the edit button next to a button to change what it does.

data_description.double_ms: How long to wait for a second press. Only applies to buttons with a double-press action.
data_description.hold_ms: How long a button must be held to count as a long press.
data_description.repeat_ms: How often the long-press action repeats while held, for buttons with repeat turned on.

user.title: Add button
user.description: Choose which button to add. For remotes that use event entities, also pick the event entities it reports through.

data_description.entities: The event entities this button reports through. Pick several to have multiple remotes share these actions.

actions.title: {button}
actions.description: Choose what each gesture does. Actions use the same editor as scripts and automations, so any action, target and data works.

data_description.short_press: Runs on release. Fires instantly unless a double-press action is set, in which case it waits briefly for a second press.
data_description.double_press: Runs on the second press. Leave empty to keep short presses instant.
data_description.long_press: Runs once the button has been held for the hold time.
data_description.long_release: Runs when a held button is let go, for example to stop a cover.
data_description.repeat: Keep re-running the long-press action while the button is held, for hold-to-dim or hold-to-raise volume.
data_description.detect_all: Watch for double and long presses even without an action for them, so automations using this button's device triggers see them. Short presses then wait briefly for a possible second press.

reconfigure.title: {button}
reconfigure.description: Choose what each gesture does. Actions use the same editor as scripts and automations, so any action, target and data works.

data_description.entities: The event entities this button reports through. Pick several to have multiple remotes share these actions.
data_description.short_press: Runs on release. Fires instantly unless a double-press action is set, in which case it waits briefly for a second press.
data_description.double_press: Runs on the second press. Leave empty to keep short presses instant.
data_description.long_press: Runs once the button has been held for the hold time.
data_description.long_release: Runs when a held button is let go, for example to stop a cover.
data_description.repeat: Keep re-running the long-press action while the button is held, for hold-to-dim or hold-to-raise volume.
data_description.detect_all: Watch for double and long presses even without an action for them, so automations using this button's device triggers see them. Short presses then wait briefly for a possible second press.

error.no_entities: Select at least one event entity.
error.already_configured: One of these event entities is already used by another button.
error.invalid_action: This action is invalid. Check the logs for details.

abort.all_buttons_added: Every button is already added to this remote.

confirm.title: Turn off {automation}?
confirm.description: {remote} was imported from this automation, so with both on, every button press runs twice. Turning the automation off fixes that. Nothing is deleted, and you can turn it back on anytime.

entities_missing.title: {remote} is missing event entities
entities_missing.description: These event entities no longer exist, so the buttons that use them can't fire: {entities}. If they were renamed or the remote was re-paired, edit those buttons on the {remote} entry and pick the new entities.

pico_missing.title: {remote}'s Pico is gone
pico_missing.description: The Pico this remote reads presses from is no longer in the Lutron Caséta integration. If you replaced or re-paired it, open Reconfigure on {remote} and pick the new Pico. Every button keeps its actions.
